reviews.title: Great bang for your buck
reviews.comment: Good quality ram sticks, very easy to install and don’t require any setup. They have maintained good performance over the last few months I’ve had them. No stability issues and video quality on YouTube has never been better. The have great speeds and are one of the best ram sticks on the market.
reviews.author: Bart Johngren

reviews.comment: Purchased them almos 1 year ago. No issues works perfect

reviews.title: Low-cost and dependability at stock settings
reviews.comment: Works well as low-cost DDR5 memorry if you are not wanting to push its specs. Still to be determined how well the wraparound heatsinks work since this will be most important attribute due it being contained in the smallest volume possible with only the CPU fan and two 50mm fans (exhaust) regulating airflow across the chassis/motherboard.
reviews.author: Jake Powers

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.comment: The price is good looks clean in the PC,  it dose run to the 6000 mhz that it's listed but on my machine it's crashed a few times running that high . seems to run much better at 4800 with no issues so not mad.
